object.description: Setup: BLE strap worn and paired; a reference heart rate (watch or chest display) is available. Steps: 1. Select Start. 2. Wait 30 s. 3. Compare the Active screen with the reference. Expected: The Active screen shows the strap as connected within 30 s of Start, and the displayed bpm is within 3 bpm of the reference (the 3 bpm tolerance is a test criterion, not a requirement).
